Subject: Update on Budget Request and Next Steps

Dear [Recipient Name],

Thank you for reviewing our recent budget increase request. We understand that the current proposal does not align with the company’s financial strategy, and we appreciate the feedback regarding the need for greater detail.

To address this, we are preparing a revised submission that includes a more comprehensive explanation and concrete examples of the anticipated benefits. We believe this additional context will better demonstrate the value of the requested resources.

In the meantime, please let us know if there are specific metrics or data points you would like us to prioritize in the resubmission. We are committed to ensuring our proposal supports the company’s current financial goals.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
